statements.statement: The patient presents with a history of recurrent syncope and palpitations
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other cardiac arrhythmias
The diagnosis codes are I49.9, I48.91, and R55
The denial reason code is PR-204
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to capture intermittent rhythm disturbances and correlate symptoms with electrocardiographic findings over an extended monitoring period
